import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    parts = line.split()
    w = int(parts[0])
    m = int(parts[1])
    
    digits = []
    while m > 0:
        digits.append(m % w)
        m //= w
    
    flag = True
    for i in range(len(digits)):
        d = digits[i]
        if d == 0 or d == 1:
            continue
        if d == w - 1:
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(digits):
                if digits[j] == w - 1:
                    digits[j] = 0
                else:
                    digits[j] = digits[j] + 1
                    break
                j += 1
        else:
            flag = False
            break
    
    print("YES" if flag else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
